Convert DNS Dynamics to Simulation Parameters

Source: R/dns-dynamics.r
dns_dynamics_to_sim_params.Rd

Converts the estimated DNS dynamics to parameters suitable for simulation.

Usage

dns_dynamics_to_sim_params(dynamics, include_correlation = TRUE, lambda = NULL)

Arguments

dynamics

List. The dynamics object from estimate_dns_dynamics().

include_correlation

Logical. If TRUE, include the correlation structure.

lambda

Numeric. The Nelson-Siegel decay parameter to carry into the simulation parameters. If NULL (the default) it is taken from dynamics$lambda when present, and otherwise falls back to 0.0609. estimate_dns_dynamics() does not estimate lambda, so pass the value fitted by fit_dns_model to avoid simulating off the default.

Value

A list of parameters for DNS simulation.

Details

kappa, theta and sigma are the per-factor values, so a dynamics object estimated with structure = "full" contributes only the diagonal of its mean-reversion matrix here: simulate_dns_factors() reverts each factor to its own long-run mean. The full matrix is carried through as kappa_matrix for inspection.

Examples

data(treasury_yields)

# Month-ends only: the dynamics are estimated on them anyway
month_ends <- treasury_yields[
  !duplicated(format(treasury_yields$Date, "%Y-%m"), fromLast = TRUE),
]
dns_result <- fit_dns_model(month_ends, n_days = nrow(month_ends),
                            show_progress = FALSE, warm_start = FALSE)
#> Warning: Parameters rest on a bound in some fits: lambda on 13 (of 72 dates). The factor decomposition is not identified on those dates; see the at_bound element of the result, pass wider lower_bounds/upper_bounds, or check the yield scale.
dynamics <- estimate_dns_dynamics(dns_result$parameters)

# Pass the fitted lambda through, rather than leaving the 0.0609 default
latest <- dns_result$parameters[which.max(dns_result$parameters$Date), ]
sim_params <- dns_dynamics_to_sim_params(dynamics, lambda = latest$lambda)
str(sim_params)
#> List of 7
#>  $ kappa       : num [1:3] 2.78 2.63 2.12
#>  $ theta       : num [1:3] 0.03456 -0.00831 -0.00431
#>  $ sigma       : num [1:3] 0.0304 0.033 0.0579
#>  $ names       : chr [1:3] "Level" "Slope" "Curvature"
#>  $ lambda      : num 0.0614
#>  $ correlation : num [1:3, 1:3] 1 -0.791 -0.549 -0.791 1 ...
#>   ..- attr(*, "dimnames")=List of 2
#>   .. ..$ : chr [1:3] "beta1" "beta2" "beta3"
#>   .. ..$ : chr [1:3] "beta1" "beta2" "beta3"
#>  $ kappa_matrix: num [1:3, 1:3] 2.78 0 0 0 2.63 ...
#>   ..- attr(*, "dimnames")=List of 2
#>   .. ..$ : chr [1:3] "beta1" "beta2" "beta3"
#>   .. ..$ : chr [1:3] "beta1" "beta2" "beta3"
